title: Content manifest
description: Identity of the authored content set. Exactly one manifest file exists.

version.description: Authored version. The build appends the content hash to form contentVersion.

compatibleContentVersions.description: Authored versions whose saves this content opens although the content hash differs: a declared compatible content transition (Technical Specification 11.4). The authored version itself is always compatible. A save from any other content version is refused.

contentFloor.description: The delivery content floor this content claims to meet (v0.2 Implementation Plan phase 0). A development milestone profile holds the completed phases; only v0.2-release passes the release gate. Absent means v0.2-release.
